about: Every survey road with what the other layers know of it: its role (street, link, driveway, a zone's way), lanes and widths — as tagged, as its lanes make it, as measured off a mapped surface and as read off imagery — building frontage each side, pavements each side, street parking, zone, land use, district, level, the ground's height at each node and the grade, surface, light, speed, trams, routes, crossings and calming.
